note: Revision 5 (third review round, "Result Domain"): a scheme now commits its resultKind (ORDERED_LEVEL / CATEGORICAL / OPAQUE) and a uint256 levelMask (bit n = level n is a declared result) as immutable semantics; attest/attestWithProof refuse undeclared levels, check reverts on minLevel == 0 and on non-ordered schemes, policy rules and bridge configuration are restricted to ordered schemes with a responseMap covering the whole mask. registerScheme takes a SchemeInput struct; IKYASchemeRegistry/IKYARegistry have new interface ids (0xe6dbd933 / 0x5d1bec61). Groth16Verifier and the adapter are unchanged since revision 4 and are reused (creation bytecode verified identical). Nonce 84 was an aborted deploy (gas schedule on Sepolia had increased ~7x since revision 4; the tx ran out of gas and created nothing usable). Deployed from a sandbox-held throwaway key; txs signed offline against browser-built digests and broadcast via public JSON-RPC.
